finding: Baseline Selection AUC (0.4015) is driven by per-month noise (mean per-month AUC=0.498, std=0.207). The model is Up-heavy and the per-month rank ordering carries no signal beyond the base rate. p_up-selection_score has 0.946 correlation with p_up, leaving the 0.4*stress - 0.15*p_down adjustment as a near-zero perturbation.
consequence: Any challenger that swaps at most 5-7% of the cohort with slightly better-conditioned indicators should improve both Selection AUC and Accuracy simultaneously without changing cap or direction policy.
experiment: Family F: recent-miss + group-stability overlay. Penalise indicators with miss rate > dynamic threshold (0.45) over 6 months fit-through-origin=t-2, and reward groups whose up-rate is above 0.5 with low variance.
